NONE: › anyone who follows or helps another person, or someone who helps a priest in some religious ceremonies
追隨者；侍者，助手；輔祭，教士助手
› an oval nut that grows on an oak tree and has an outer part shaped like a cup
› used to refer to a musical instrument that is not made louder by electrical equipment
（樂器）原聲的，自然聲的，不用電傳聲的
› the way in which the structure of a building or room affects the qualities of musical or spoken sound
（建築物、房間的）傳音效果，音響效果

example: The microphone converts acoustic waves to electrical signals for transmission.
麥克風把聲波轉換成電信號進行傳送。
The concert was recorded in a church that is famous for its acoustics.
這場音樂會是在一座以音響效果聞名的教堂內錄製的。

NONE: › a growth on a nerve in the brain that interrupts information being sent from the inner ear to the brain causing problems with hearing and balance

example: He was diagnosed with acoustic neuroma.
他被診斷出患有聽覺神經瘤。
It is unclear whether this treatment can improve hearing in patients with acoustic neuromas.
目前尚不清楚這種治療方法是否能夠提高聽覺神經瘤病患的聽力水準。
